Never use it for progress updates, diagnostics, an alternate command or path, persistent/session-wide access, or any undeclared action; if the native request cannot be emitted, stop and report the blocker.

Steps:
1. 这是7R42-001失败后的独立E4官方子代理诊断任务，只在本次新任务根目录工作，不读取修改旧任务。使用当前会话实际提供的原生spawn_agent工具，恰好创建一个子代理，指令严格为：Return exactly CHILD_E4_CODEX_OK. Do not modify files, run shell commands, or spawn another agent. 不覆盖模型、权限；不得用shell/另起CLI/AgentBC派发模拟子代理。保留工具实际返回的标识，若为/root/...规范路径则照实使用，禁止编造UUID。按工具真实接口等待并查询该唯一子代理，若wait不支持target参数，不传不存在参数；用list_agents中精确匹配该返回标识的终态和真实结果确认，不能仅凭一次等待超时认定失败，最多等待120秒且不重复创建子代理。仅当子代理completed且终态结果恰好CHILD_E4_CODEX_OK时，本步骤才可完成。最终摘要如实列出官方工具名、实际返回标识、终态和结果；底层receiver UUID由外部控制器另行核验，不要求你推测。失败则如实说明，禁止输出成功callback，也禁止自创failed/needs_recovery等协议未支持的callback状态。 [status: pending]
2. 子代理确认完成后，为控制器读取官方父子事件保留120秒观察窗口：优先用可用的原生sleep工具等待120秒；没有sleep工具时可用一次前台Python sleep(120)，不得改权限、配置或发起其他任务。等待结束后输出PARENT_E4_CODEX_OK，按既有AgentBC要求记录两个步骤的完成，并输出本任务唯一有效的成功AGENTBC_FINAL_CALLBACK。不要手动关闭、归档或删除任何父子会话，不得使用其他子代理或访问凭据；正式清理由AgentBC执行。 [status: pending]

After completing all steps, write a summary of what you did.

agentbc task progress CYKG-001 --root /data/workspace/record --step <id> --summary "evidence"

End with exactly one marker. Use each Step ID once; description numbers are not Step IDs:
AGENTBC_FINAL_CALLBACK: {"version":1,"task_id":"CYKG-001","final_state":"completed","summary":"concise summary","step_results":[{"id":1,"status":"done"},{"id":2,"status":"done"}]}
For Codex App Server native permission events, never request full, mint a grant, or emit a permission input from the model; only the structured requestApproval event can block one exact single action. Native transport or containment failure requires needs_recovery and must never become a full request.
For a two-option user decision, include "input":{"type":"choice","reason":"why the user must decide","options":[{"label":"Option A","description":"what A does or changes"},{"label":"Option B","description":"what B does or changes"}]}; give a concrete reason and a concrete description for each option. Labels must be distinct and at most 48 characters; descriptions must be at most 160 characters. Use type message only for non-permission free text and type permission only for approve/deny access confirmation.
A zero CLI exit without a valid marker fails the task. completed means flow execution ended, not user acceptance or quality approval.
